## Covariate efficacy effects

This page shows one efficacy-effect line chart per available covariate. The outcome proxy is a symptom-free indicator derived from the daily survey data, and each point reports the average symptom-free rate within that covariate group.

> Note: the provided CSV files do not contain a usable sex or gender column, so no real sex-based chart can be produced from this dataset without an additional source variable.

```{python}
#| label: build-effect-charts
#| echo: false

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

output_dir = Path("images/effect")
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

age_order = ["0.5-04", "05-11", "12-19", "20-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70-79", "80+"]
dose_order = ["First", "Second", "Third", "Fourth", "Fifth"]
state_order = ["Excellent", "Very good", "Good", "Fair", "Poor"]
binary_order = ["No", "Yes"]

vax = pd.read_csv("covid_vaccination.csv", low_memory=False)
daily = pd.read_csv("covid_daily_survey.csv", low_memory=False)

daily_clean = daily[["VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID", "HAD_SYMPTOMS"]].dropna().copy()
daily_clean["HAD_SYMPTOMS"] = daily_clean["HAD_SYMPTOMS"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
daily_clean = daily_clean[daily_clean["HAD_SYMPTOMS"].isin(["yes", "no"])].copy()

participant = daily_clean.groupby("VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID").agg(
	symptom_free=("HAD_SYMPTOMS", lambda values: int((values == "no").all())),
).reset_index()

analysis = participant.merge(
	vax[[
		"VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID",
		"COVID_VACCINE_HISTORY",
		"COVID_VACCINE_DOSES",
		"COVID_VACCINE",
		"COADMINISTERED",
		"COADMINISTERED_VACCINE",
		"IMMUNOCOMPROMISED",
		"CURRENT_STATE",
		"SEEN_DOCTOR",
		"HOSPITALIZED",
		"age_at_vax_yrs",
		"DOSE_NUMBER",
		"LANGUAGE",
	]],
	on="VSAFE_SYSTEM_ID",
	how="inner",
)

analysis = analysis.dropna(subset=["age_at_vax_yrs", "DOSE_NUMBER", "CURRENT_STATE"])
analysis = analysis[analysis["age_at_vax_yrs"] != "Invalid"].copy()

def make_summary(column, order=None, top_n=None):
	frame = analysis[[column, "symptom_free"]].dropna().copy()
	frame[column] = frame[column].astype(str).str.strip()

	if top_n is not None and frame[column].nunique() > top_n:
		top_values = frame[column].value_counts().head(top_n).index.tolist()
		frame[column] = frame[column].where(frame[column].isin(top_values), other="Other")
		order = top_values + ["Other"]

	if order is not None:
		frame[column] = pd.Categorical(frame[column], categories=order, ordered=True)
		summary = frame.groupby(column, observed=True)["symptom_free"].mean().reset_index()
	else:
		summary = frame.groupby(column)["symptom_free"].mean().reset_index()
		summary = summary.sort_values(column)

	summary["symptom_free_pct"] = summary["symptom_free"] * 100
	return summary


def save_line_chart(column, title, filename, order=None, top_n=None):
	summary = make_summary(column, order=order, top_n=top_n)
	positions = range(len(summary))

	fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
	ax.plot(positions, summary["symptom_free_pct"], marker="o", linewidth=2.2, color="#215a8e")
	ax.set_title(title)
	ax.set_ylabel("Symptom-free rate (%)")
	ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
	ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
	ax.set_xticks(list(positions))
	ax.set_xticklabels(summary[column].astype(str), rotation=35, ha="right")
	ax.set_xlabel("")
	fig.tight_layout()
	fig.savefig(output_dir / filename, dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
	plt.close(fig)


save_line_chart("COVID_VACCINE_HISTORY", "COVID vaccine history", "manufacturer.png", order=binary_order)
save_line_chart("age_at_vax_yrs", "Age group", "age_group.png", order=age_order)
save_line_chart("CURRENT_STATE", "Current health state", "current_state.png", order=state_order)
save_line_chart("IMMUNOCOMPROMISED", "Immunocompromised status", "immunocompromised.png", order=["No", "Yes", "Unknown/prefer not to answer"])
save_line_chart("SEEN_DOCTOR", "Doctors seen", "seen_doctor.png")
save_line_chart("HOSPITALIZED", "Hospitalization", "hospitalized.png", order=["No", "Do not know/cannot recall", "Yes"])
save_line_chart("DOSE_NUMBER", "Dose number", "dose_number.png", order=dose_order)
save_line_chart("COADMINISTERED", "Co-administered vaccine", "coadministered.png", order=binary_order)
save_line_chart("COVID_VACCINE", "COVID vaccine", "covid_vaccine.png")
save_line_chart("LANGUAGE", "Language", "language.png")
```

### Notes

- These charts are exploratory and use a symptom-free proxy as the efficacy outcome.
- A true sex covariate would require a sex/gender field in the underlying dataset.
